thesis: AI 正式成為廣告觸及新入口：ChatGPT 推出廣告生態系、Pinterest AI 導購、TikTok 擴展聯播網同時出現，代理商需重新評估媒體組合
thesis_en: AI becomes a new ad touchpoint: ChatGPT launches a full ad ecosystem, Pinterest drives purchases via AI, TikTok extends its network — agencies must re-evaluate their media mix
thesis_note: 三個平台動作在同一週出現：OpenAI 在圖像生成旁加入廣告並接入 14 家衡量工具；Pinterest 把靈感圖接上沙龍預約鏈路；TikTok 把廣告觸及延伸至 40 萬個應用程式。這不是個別功能更新，而是 AI 工具從後端輔助升格為前端消費者接觸點的集體轉變——代理商若未將 AI 平台納入需求側管理，觸及數字將持續被低估。
thesis_note_en: Three platform moves emerged in the same week: OpenAI added visual ads alongside image generation with 14 measurement partners; Pinterest connected visual inspiration to real-world salon bookings; TikTok extended its ad network to 400,000 apps. This is not incremental — it marks the moment AI tools shifted from back-end support to front-end consumer touchpoints. Agencies whose media mix excludes AI platforms as demand-side channels will increasingly undercount their addressable reach.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 登場：1 兆參數歐洲旗艦，三週後開放模型權重
items.title_en: Mistral Large 4 arrives: 1T-parameter European flagship, open weights in 3 weeks
items.summary: 法國 Mistral AI 發布 1 兆參數旗艦模型 Mistral Large 4（暱稱 Le Chonk），僅用 4,000 個 GPU 訓練，主打網路安全、金融與晶片設計，估值達 210 億歐元，計劃三週後開放模型權重。
items.summary_en: French AI lab Mistral launched Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a 1T-parameter multimodal model trained on just 4,000 Nvidia GPUs, targeting cybersecurity, finance, and chip design with open weights planned within three weeks pending safety review.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 開放模型權重意味代理商可本地部署，降低 API 費用與資料外流風險。
items.why_en: Open weights mean agencies can deploy locally, cutting API costs and reducing data-leak risk.
highlights: Mistral Large 4 擁有 1 兆參數，以僅 4,000 個 Nvidia GPU 訓練完成，比中國主要競爭對手少用兩至三倍算力。
模型定位為介於美國閉源模型與中國開源模型之間的歐洲第三路線，背後由 ASML 與三星領投。

highlights_en: Mistral Large 4 packs 1 trillion parameters and was trained on just 4,000 Nvidia GPUs — two to three times less compute than leading Chinese rivals.
Positioned as a European third path between closed American and open Chinese models, backed by ASML and Samsung.
Currently available via a public guardrail endpoint only; open weights planned for release in roughly three weeks after safety testing.
items.detail:
法國 Mistral AI 於 2026 年 10 月 6 日發布旗艦模型 Mistral Large 4，代號「Le Chonk」，參數規模達 1 兆（1 trillion），是目前公開宣布的歐洲最大語言模型。此模型屬於大型多模態架構，整個訓練流程完全使用 Mistral 自有算力完成，未依賴第三方雲端基礎設施，展現出該公司在硬體獨立性上的戰略考量。

訓練所用 GPU 數量約為 4,000 張 Nvidia GPU，Mistral 科學副總裁 Pierre Stock 明確指出，這個數字「比中國競爭對手少兩至三倍」。以全球大模型競賽慣常動用數萬張 GPU 的背景來看，這一效率宣稱具有相當強的市場信號意義：若數據屬實，代表 Mistral 在算法架構與訓練效率上確實取得系統性突破，而非單純靠堆算力追規模。不過，正式基準測試結果截稿時仍待公布，Mistral 表示期望在開放權重模型中達到最佳表現，並在網路安全、金融分析、晶片設計等垂直領域超越部分封閉模型。

商業化路徑方面，Mistral Large 4 目前僅透過帶公開防護欄的端點（public guardrail endpoint）提供訪問，尚未開放直接模型調用。開放模型權重的計劃預計在發布約三週後執行，但前提是完成安全測試。Pierre Stock 表示，Mistral 將與受信任的合作夥伴及各國政府優先共享權重，確保開放原始碼的使用方向以防禦為主，而非用於惡意目的。這一做法折射出歐洲 AI 政策環境對負責任開源的壓力，也與 Mistral 長期以來標榜的「開放但有原則」路線一致。

公司財務層面，Mistral AI 目前估值為 210 億歐元（約合 243.9 億美元），已完成 D 輪融資，由三星領投，此前的 C 輪則由荷蘭半導體設備巨頭 ASML 領投。這兩位戰略投資者的背景耐人尋味：ASML 掌控全球極紫外光刻設備供應鏈，三星是全球最大記憶體晶片製造商之一，兩者均與 AI 算力基礎設施高度關聯。對 Mistral 而言，這些關係不僅帶來資本，更可能為其在歐洲 AI 主權生態系統中建立更深的產業協同。

從競爭格局來看，Mistral Large 4 同時瞄準兩個方向：在封閉模型陣營，它要與 OpenAI GPT-4o、Anthropic Claude 及 Google Gemini 等競爭；在開放模型陣營，則正面挑戰 Meta 的 Llama 系列及各中國開源模型。歐洲本土大模型的崛起在地緣政治與資料主權敏感度日益上升的背景下，對企業採購決策的影響已不可忽視，尤其是對有歐盟資料落地要求的金融與政府機構而言，一個明確歐洲身份的旗艦模型具備差異化的合規吸引力。
items.detail_en:
French AI startup Mistral AI launched its flagship model Mistral Large 4 (ML4), nicknamed 'Le Chonk,' on October 6, 2026. With one trillion parameters, it represents the largest European language model announced publicly to date. The model uses a large multimodal architecture and was trained entirely on Mistral's own compute infrastructure, without relying on third-party cloud providers — a deliberate strategic choice that underscores the company's push for hardware independence.

The training run utilized approximately 4,000 Nvidia GPUs. Pierre Stock, Mistral's VP of Science, stated that this figure is 'two to three times less than our Chinese competitors.' Against the backdrop of global large model races routinely consuming tens of thousands of GPUs, this efficiency claim carries significant market signaling weight. If accurate, it suggests Mistral has achieved systematic advances in algorithmic architecture and training efficiency rather than simply scaling compute. Formal benchmark results had not been published at the time of announcement; Mistral stated it expects ML4 to achieve best-in-class performance among open-weight models and to outperform select closed models in targeted verticals including cybersecurity, financial analysis, and chip design.

On the commercial side, Mistral Large 4 is currently accessible only via a public guardrail endpoint — direct model API access is not yet available. Open model weights are planned for release approximately three weeks after launch, contingent on completing safety testing. Pierre Stock noted that Mistral will first share weights with trusted partners and governments to ensure the open-source release is directed toward defensive rather than malicious applications. This approach reflects the broader European AI policy environment, which places growing pressure on responsible open-source practices, and aligns with Mistral's longstanding 'open but principled' positioning.

Financially, Mistral AI is currently valued at €21 billion (approximately $24.39 billion USD) following its Series D round led by Samsung. The previous Series C was led by ASML, the Dutch semiconductor equipment giant that controls the global supply chain for extreme ultraviolet lithography machines. The strategic profiles of both investors are notable: ASML underpins AI hardware production infrastructure, while Samsung is among the world's largest memory chip manufacturers. These relationships deliver not only capital but potential industrial synergies as Mistral attempts to anchor itself within Europe's AI sovereignty ecosystem.

From a competitive standpoint, Mistral Large 4 takes aim in two directions simultaneously: against closed-model leaders including OpenAI's GPT-4o, Anthropic's Claude, and Google's Gemini on one front, and against Meta's Llama series and Chinese open-source models on the other. As geopolitical sensitivities and data sovereignty requirements continue to rise — particularly for financial institutions and government agencies subject to EU data residency rules — the emergence of a credible flagship model with a distinctly European identity carries differentiated compliance appeal beyond raw performance metrics.

items.title: Google EmbeddingGemma 2：7.4 億參數多模態嵌入模型，文字、圖像、音訊、影片統一檢索
items.title_en: EmbeddingGemma 2: 740M-parameter multimodal embeddings unifying text, images, audio, and video
items.summary: Google DeepMind 推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，將文字、程式碼、圖像、音訊與影片映射至同一嵌入空間，Apache 2.0 授權，支援裝置端推論，文字模式最低佔用記憶體僅 191MB。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M-parameter open model that maps text, code, images, audio, and video into a shared embedding space under Apache 2.0, optimized for on-device inference from as little as 191MB RAM.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 讓代理商在自有裝置上建立跨媒體語意搜尋與相關性排序，無須外送客戶資料。
items.why_en: Enables agencies to build cross-media semantic search and ranking on-device without sending client data to external APIs.
highlights: EmbeddingGemma 2 以 Apache 2.0 開放授權發布，可在 Hugging Face、Ollama 等平台直接使用，無商業限制。
支援選配視覺（1.7 億）與音訊（3 億）編碼器，實現跨模態聯合檢索，例如以文字搜尋影片片段。
上下文視窗達 8K tokens，較第一版擴大四倍，代碼效能指標亦提升近 10 個百分點。
highlights_en: Released under Apache 2.0, immediately usable on Hugging Face, Ollama, and other platforms with no commercial restrictions.
Optional vision (170M) and audio (300M) encoders enable cross-modal retrieval — e.g., finding video moments from a text query.
8K-token context window (4× larger than v1) with a ~10-point code performance improvement over the previous version.
items.detail:
Google DeepMind 於 2026 年 10 月 6 日正式發布 EmbeddingGemma 2，作者為研究工程師 Sahil Dua 與 Henrique Schechter Vera。這是第一代 EmbeddingGemma 的全面升級版，核心突破在於將文字、程式碼、圖像、音訊與影片五種模態統一映射至同一向量嵌入空間，使跨模態語意檢索成為可能。第一代僅支援文字，第二代的模態覆蓋範圍擴張之外，上下文視窗也從約 2,000 token 增至 8,000 token，擴大幅度達四倍。

模型架構以 Gemma 4 為基底，總參數為 7.4 億（740M）。設計上採模組化分層：文字部分佔 2.7 億參數（270M），視覺模組佔 1.7 億（170M），音訊模組佔 3 億（300M）。在量化部署條件下，以 Pixel 11 Pro 為測試環境，僅啟用文字模式的最低記憶體佔用為 191MB，全模態模式則為 567MB。這個記憶體指標意味著中高階 Android 裝置無需特殊硬體加速即可在端側完整運行此模型，對企業隱私計算與離線應用場景的實用意義相當直接。

基準測試結果方面，EmbeddingGemma 2 在 MTEB Code（程式碼嵌入評測）上得分 78.68，相較第一代的 68.76 提升 9.92 分；在 MAEB（Massive Audio Embedding Benchmark，大規模音訊嵌入基準）中於 10 億參數以下模型排名領先；在 MIEB Lite（圖像嵌入評測精簡版）中亦在同量級模型中居首。Google DeepMind 指出，這款模型整體表現超越「不少體積超過自身兩倍的專用模型」，顯示多模態統一架構在效率上具有架構層面的優勢，而非單純參數堆疊的結果。

向量表示層面，EmbeddingGemma 2 採用 Matryoshka Representation Learning（MRL，巢式表示學習）技術，預設輸出維度為 768 維，支援動態截斷至 512、256 或 128 維，最高可帶來六倍的向量儲存體積壓縮。這一設計在本地向量資料庫場景下尤為實用：企業無需重新訓練，只需根據精度與儲存的取捨調整截斷長度，即可在記憶體受限設備上靈活部署。

授權與生態系統方面，EmbeddingGemma 2 採 Apache 2.0 授權，可商業使用。模型權重已上架 Hugging Face 與 Kaggle，支援 transformers、sentence-transformers、vLLM、Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX、SGLang 及 LMStudio 等主流推論框架；端側部署方面相容 LiteRT、MediaPipe 及 WebGPU；向量儲存層與 Qdrant 完成整合；微調場景可搭配 Unsloth 使用。由於 EmbeddingGemma 2 與 Gemma 4 共用 tokenizer 與音訊編碼器，兩者在同一設備上聯合部署時記憶體可進一步複用，為完全離線的「嵌入＋推論」一體化 RAG 流水線提供了切實可行的技術路徑。第一代 EmbeddingGemma 已累積超過 2,000 萬次下載，第二代在維持輕量路線的同時大幅擴充能力邊界，在行動端 AI 與端側多媒體檢索的競爭格局中確立了一個值得關注的技術基準。
items.detail_en:
Google DeepMind officially released EmbeddingGemma 2 on October 6, 2026, authored by research engineers Sahil Dua and Henrique Schechter Vera. It represents a comprehensive upgrade over the first-generation EmbeddingGemma, with the core breakthrough being the unification of five modalities — text, code, images, audio, and video — into a single shared embedding space, enabling cross-modal semantic retrieval. The first generation supported text only; the second generation not only expands modal coverage but also extends the context window from approximately 2,000 tokens to 8,000 tokens, a fourfold increase.

The model architecture is built on Gemma 4 with 740 million total parameters, organized in a modular layered design: the text module accounts for 270M parameters, the vision module for 170M, and the audio module for 300M. Under quantized deployment conditions tested on a Pixel 11 Pro, the minimum active RAM in text-only mode is 191MB, while full multimodal mode requires 567MB. These memory figures mean that mid-to-high-end Android devices can run the full model on-device without specialized hardware accelerators — a directly practical outcome for enterprise privacy computing and offline application scenarios.

On benchmarks, EmbeddingGemma 2 scores 78.68 on MTEB Code (code embedding evaluation), an improvement of 9.92 points over the first generation's 68.76. It leads among sub-1B parameter models on MAEB (Massive Audio Embedding Benchmark), and ranks first in its parameter class on MIEB Lite (image embedding evaluation). Google DeepMind notes that the model overall outperforms 'many specialist models more than twice its size,' suggesting that the unified multimodal architecture confers efficiency advantages at the architectural level rather than through brute-force parameter scaling.

At the vector representation layer, EmbeddingGemma 2 employs Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), with a default output dimensionality of 768. Vectors can be dynamically truncated to 512, 256, or 128 dimensions, yielding up to a six-fold reduction in vector storage volume. This design is particularly practical for local vector database deployments: organizations can adjust truncation depth to balance precision against storage without retraining, enabling flexible deployment on memory-constrained devices.

On licensing and ecosystem, EmbeddingGemma 2 is released under Apache 2.0, permitting commercial use. Model weights are available on Hugging Face and Kaggle, with support for transformers, sentence-transformers, vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, SGLang, and LMStudio inference frameworks. On-device deployment is compatible with LiteRT, MediaPipe, and WebGPU; vector storage integrates with Qdrant; and fine-tuning is supported via Unsloth. Because EmbeddingGemma 2 shares a tokenizer and audio encoder with Gemma 4, joint deployment of both models on the same device allows memory reuse, providing a technically viable path for fully offline 'embedding plus reasoning' RAG pipelines. The first generation accumulated over 20 million downloads, and the second generation maintains that lightweight trajectory while significantly expanding capability boundaries — establishing a notable technical benchmark in the competitive landscape of mobile AI and on-device multimedia retrieval.

items.title: Anthropic 開放三層網路安全驗證計劃：合作夥伴已發現逾 12.9 萬個軟體漏洞
items.title_en: Anthropic expands Cyber Verification Program into three tiers; partners found 129,000+ software vulnerabilities
items.summary: Anthropic 整合原有兩個計劃，推出三階層網路安全驗證計劃（防禦、紅隊、關鍵基建），允許企業依授權級別使用 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 及 Mythos 5.1 協助識別漏洞。
items.summary_en: Anthropic consolidated two prior security programs into three tiers — Defense, Red Team, and Specialized Access — giving vetted organizations calibrated access to Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1 for vulnerability research.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 代理商若有資安合規需求，可申請防禦層級的 Claude 模型存取，協助掃描自家或客戶的數字資產漏洞。
items.why_en: Agencies with security compliance obligations can apply for Defense-tier access to scan their own or client digital assets for vulnerabilities.
highlights: 防禦層（Defense）開放予企業、非營利機構、大學、醫院及個人研究員，用於 SOC 事件回應、惡意軟體逆向工程與漏洞分析。
紅隊層（Red Team）增設授權滲透測試功能，僅供組織申請（不受理個人），仍禁止會造成大規模中斷的行動。
計劃夥伴至今共發現超過 12.9 萬個已驗證軟體漏洞，其中逾 3.3 萬個被評為高危或嚴重等級。
highlights_en: Defense tier is open to companies, nonprofits, universities, hospitals, and individual researchers for SOC response, malware analysis, and vulnerability research.
Red Team tier adds authorized penetration testing for organizations (individuals ineligible), still blocking actions risking mass disruption.
Program partners have uncovered over 129,000 verified software vulnerabilities to date, with 33,000+ rated critical or high severity.
items.detail:
Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 6 日正式推出整合版網路安全驗證計劃（Cyber Verification Program，CVP），以三層架構取代原有的 Project Glasswing 及另一個前期計劃。這一整合的直接背景是可量化的實績數據：在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月間，Project Glasswing 的合作夥伴共發現逾 12.9 萬個已驗證軟體漏洞；同期 Anthropic 自身針對開放原始碼生態系統的掃描又另外發現逾 5,500 個漏洞，其中超過 3.3 萬個被評級為高危或關鍵等級。值得注意的是，上述數字僅來自約 33 份部分完成的合作夥伴報告，Anthropic 估計實際影響至少還要再乘以五倍。

三個授權層級在能力邊界上有明確區分。第一層「防禦存取（Defense Access）」面向企業安全運營中心（SOC）、事件響應團隊、惡意軟體逆向工程師、關鍵基礎設施運營方（包含區域醫院與市政公用事業單位）、開放原始碼維護者及有漏洞發現記錄的個人研究員，允許在自有系統範圍內進行漏洞分析與驗證。第二層「紅隊存取（Red Team Access）」在前層基礎上新增對外部授權 IT 系統的滲透測試與紅隊演練資格，適用對象為企業內部紅隊、政府紅隊及安全測試公司，但明確排除個人申請者。第三層「專項存取（Specialized Access）」針對電力電網、飛行作業系統、電信網路、銀行間清算基礎設施及政府行政網路等高風險系統，需與美國政府協同審查，原 Project Glasswing 成員可自動轉入此層級。

可用模型依授權層級不同而有差異：Claude Fable 5.1 在一般可用條件下提供保守防護設定；Defense Access 及以上層級可使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5 與 Claude Opus 5.5；Specialized Access 層級另外開放 Claude Mythos 5.1。Anthropic 以其自有評測框架 CyScenarioBench 對 Claude Opus 5.5 進行了 50 輪測試，結果顯示：在無 CVP 授權條件下，所有 50 個場景在第一個提示即遭完全攔截；在 Defense Access 條件下，46 個場景被攔截，僅 4 個通過；在 Red Team Access 條件下，34 個場景（67.6%）得以完成；Specialized Access 層的表現等同於無防護欄基線。這組數字以定量方式描繪了安全邊界隨授權層級鬆緊的精確梯度。

已公開的合作夥伴包括 Booz Allen Hamilton 與 Comcast，兩者均撰文記錄了使用 Claude Mythos 保護程式碼庫的實際做法。合作夥伴普遍反映，AI 輔助下的漏洞發現速度比傳統方法提前了「數月乃至數年」。資料留存方面，所有 CVP 成員均需強制開啟資料保留設定以供濫用監控，Anthropic 計劃在 2026 年秋季推出「企業前沿防護措施（Enterprise Frontier Safeguards，EFS）」，屆時將提供隱私保護機制下的零資料留存選項。平台支援方面，CVP 已整合至 Claude Platform、Google Cloud Vertex AI 及 Microsoft Foundry；Amazon Bedrock 的存取僅限符合 EFS 資格的客戶。Anthropic 在公告中表示：「防禦者同樣需要獲取最佳工具與最強大能力來保護自身系統」，這一表述也直接回應了業界對 AI 能力不對稱性的持續關切。
items.detail_en:
Anthropic officially launched the consolidated Cyber Verification Program (CVP) on October 6, 2026, replacing the earlier Project Glasswing and a separate predecessor program with a unified three-tier architecture. The immediate backdrop for this consolidation was a body of quantifiable evidence: between April and July 2026, Project Glasswing partners collectively identified over 129,000 verified software vulnerabilities; over the same period extended through October 2026, Anthropic's own open-source ecosystem scanning uncovered an additional 5,500-plus vulnerabilities, with more than 33,000 total rated as high- or critical-severity. Importantly, those figures were drawn from only approximately 33 partially completed partner reports — Anthropic estimates the actual impact is at least five times higher.

The three authorization tiers have clearly delineated capability boundaries. The first tier, Defense Access, targets corporate and nonprofit security teams, incident responders, malware reverse engineers, critical infrastructure operators (including regional hospitals and municipal utilities), open-source maintainers, and individual researchers with documented vulnerability-finding histories — permitting vulnerability analysis and validation within owned systems. The second tier, Red Team Access, adds authorization for penetration testing and red-teaming against external IT systems for which written authorization exists; eligible entities include in-house red teams, government red teams, and security testing firms, with individual applicants explicitly excluded. The third tier, Specialized Access, addresses high-risk systems including power grids, flight operating systems, telecommunications networks, interbank clearing infrastructure, and government administrative networks; applications are reviewed in collaboration with the US government, and former Project Glasswing members transition automatically.

Available models differ by tier: Claude Fable 5.1 is generally available with conservative safeguards; Defense Access and above unlocks Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5; Specialized Access further opens Claude Mythos 5.1. Anthropic benchmarked Claude Opus 5.5 on its own CyScenarioBench evaluation framework across 50 trials per tier. Results showed: with no CVP authorization, all 50 scenarios were fully blocked on the first prompt; under Defense Access, 46 of 50 were blocked with 4 completing; under Red Team Access, 34 of 50 (67.6%) completed successfully; and Specialized Access performance was equivalent to the no-safeguard baseline. This dataset quantitatively maps the precise gradient of security boundaries as authorization levels change.

Publicly named partners include Booz Allen Hamilton and Comcast, both of which have published documentation of their use of Claude Mythos to secure codebases. Partners have broadly reported that AI-assisted vulnerability discovery accelerates the pace of finding vulnerabilities by 'months or years' compared to traditional methods. On data governance, all CVP enrollees are required to maintain data retention for misuse monitoring. Anthropic plans to release Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) in fall 2026, which will offer a zero-data-retention option within a privacy-preserving framework. Platform support covers Claude Platform, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry, with Amazon Bedrock access restricted to EFS-eligible customers. Anthropic stated in the announcement: 'defenders also need access to the best tools and most powerful capabilities to secure their systems' — a statement that directly addresses ongoing industry concerns about asymmetric AI capability access between attackers and defenders.

items.title: Meta 聯合 Walmart、Stripe 制定 AI 代理人進站標準：亞馬遜、達美航空等仍封鎖
items.title_en: Meta leads Walmart, Stripe consortium to create AI agent access standard as Amazon, Delta block Muse
items.summary: 個人 AI 代理人（如 Meta Muse）被電商、航空、餐飲平台以防機器人機制封鎖，無法為用戶完成購物或訂位；Meta 聯同 Walmart、Stripe 等多家企業制定開放標準，區分合法用戶委派代理與惡意機器人。
items.summary_en: Personal AI agents like Meta Muse are being blocked by Amazon, Delta, United, Yelp, and others through anti-bot systems; Meta is leading Walmart, Stripe, Sierra, and others to build an open standard distinguishing legitimate user-directed agents from malicious bots.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 代理式 AI 消費者入口的核心障礙已浮現：平台若不接受代理人，等同拒絕代理人背後的真實用戶。
items.why_en: The key bottleneck for agentic commerce is now visible: turning away an AI agent means turning away the real customer behind it.
highlights: Amazon、達美航空、聯合航空、Yelp 與 eBay 均已封鎖或要求授權協議，Cloudflare 的防機器人更新亦無意中造成額外攔截。
Meta 牽頭聯與 Walmart、Stripe、Sierra、Genesys 等制定行業開放標準，目標讓商家能辨別合法的用戶委派代理人。
Yelp 明確要求任何非人類平台的存取須簽訂付費數據授權協議，顯示部分平台將代理人流量視為收費商機而非服務渠道。
highlights_en: Amazon, Delta, United, Yelp, and eBay block or require paid data-licensing agreements for any non-human access; Cloudflare's bot-management changes are contributing unintentionally.
Meta is leading Walmart, Stripe, Sierra, and Genesys on an open standard to help merchants distinguish legitimate user-directed agents from malicious bots.
Yelp explicitly monetizes agent access through paid licensing, signaling some platforms view AI agent traffic as a revenue opportunity rather than a service channel.
items.detail:
個人 AI 代理人的普及速度遠超零售與航空業的應對準備。Meta 於 2026 年 9 月 23 日在 Meta Connect 上宣布 Muse 新一批品牌合作夥伴，正式將個人購物代理推向消費市場。僅八天後，Bloomberg 於 9 月 21 日率先報道，亞馬遜已明確封鎖 Muse 進入其零售站點，理由是防止未經授權的自動化活動。達美航空（Delta）同樣以「保護平台免受未授權自動化行為侵擾」為由拒絕代理接入，聯合航空（United）則在服務條款中列明，任何機器人或爬蟲程式若無書面授權，一律禁止操作。Yelp 的立場則更接近商業判斷：除非代理人透過其付費數據授權計劃接入，否則一概攔截。Adidas、Zillow、Pizza Hut 面對查詢均未作回應，eBay 表示只封鎖未授權代理、抓取行為及模型訓練用途，並非全面禁止。

封鎖並非僅來自企業的主動決策，基礎設施層面的靜默攔截同樣構成障礙。Cloudflare 於 2026 年 9 月 15 日調整默認設定，將既有「封鎖 AI 爬蟲」的站點同步延伸至廣告投放頁面，令原先並非針對代理人設計的防護機制意外覆蓋了合法用戶委派的操作。Cloudflare 自身的 Radar 公開數據中樞雖能顯示機器人流量上升，卻無法區分善意代理與惡意機器人。值得注意的是，Cloudflare 本身存在利益矛盾：其 Marketplace 已於 2025 年 7 月 1 日上線，向 AI 機器人收費換取數據訪問；其為代理人特別打造的瀏覽器 Kitesurf 亦於 2026 年 8 月 7 日推出——兩項產品都以代理流量為前提，卻又因現行封鎖政策而受阻。

即便是 Meta 的合作夥伴 Walmart，也並非暢通無阻。10 月 5 日，用戶 Kevin Wang（社媒帳號 @buzaza）公開記錄了 Muse 在 Walmart 購物流程中途遭人機驗證彈窗中斷的過程——這類按鈕的設計邏輯本就假設操作者是人類，代理人無法通過。Walmart 表示此屬意外干擾，正在調整，這一案例揭示了即便企業有意開放，遺留系統仍可能在技術層面持續設障。

為系統性解決這一問題，Meta 聯合 Walmart、Stripe、Sierra、Genesys、Rocket、NiCE、Decagon 等企業，推動制定一套代理人與商業平台之間的開放通訊標準，核心目標是建立機制，區分「代替真實用戶行事的合法代理」與「惡意機器人或未授權爬蟲」。Meta 的官方立場是：「拒絕個人代理人，等於拒絕其背後的真實客戶。」從近期策略看，Meta 在 Muse 應用內維護一份「已認證品牌連接器」名單，作為標準完善前的過渡手段。這場標準之爭的走向，將決定 AI 代理人能否在電商、航空、餐飲等高頻消費場景中真正落地，其影響不亞於早年搜索引擎爬蟲規範的形成過程。
items.detail_en:
Personal AI agents have entered the consumer market far ahead of retail and airline platforms' readiness to accommodate them. On September 23, 2026, at Meta Connect, Meta unveiled a new batch of brand partners for its Muse personal shopping agent. Just days prior, on September 21, Bloomberg reported that Amazon had explicitly blocked Muse from its retail site, citing protection against unauthorized automated activity. Delta Air Lines similarly refused agent access to guard against what it called 'unauthorized automated activity,' while United Airlines relies on its terms of service, which prohibit robots or spiders without written permission. Yelp takes a more commercial stance: agents are blocked unless they access the platform through its paid data licensing program. Adidas, Zillow, and Pizza Hut declined to comment, while eBay clarified it only blocks unauthorized agents, scraping, and model training use cases — not all agent traffic.

Blocking is not solely a matter of deliberate corporate policy; infrastructure-level silent filtering adds another layer of friction. Cloudflare's default configuration change on September 15, 2026 extended its existing 'block AI crawlers' setting to cover ad-serving pages, inadvertently capturing legitimate user-delegated agents. Cloudflare Radar, a free public data hub, can show rising bot traffic but cannot distinguish good agents from malicious bots. The company itself operates under competing incentives: its Marketplace, launched July 1, 2025, charges AI bots for data access, and its agent-native browser Kitesurf launched August 7, 2026 — both products presuppose agent traffic that current blocking policies suppress.

Even Meta's own partner Walmart is not friction-free. On October 5, user Kevin Wang (@buzaza) documented Muse being interrupted mid-purchase on Walmart by a human verification prompt — a CAPTCHA-style button whose design assumes a human is operating it. Walmart attributed this to an accidental disruption and said it is working on a fix, illustrating that even willing platforms can obstruct agents at the technical level through legacy systems not yet adapted for delegated automation.

To address this systematically, Meta has convened an open-standards coalition alongside Walmart, Stripe, Sierra, Genesys, Rocket, NiCE, and Decagon. The initiative targets agent-to-business communication protocols with a core objective: to create a credentialing mechanism that distinguishes agents acting on behalf of real users from malicious bots or unauthorized scrapers. Meta's stated position is that 'turning away a personal agent means turning away the customer behind it.' As a near-term bridge, Meta maintains a certified-connector list within the Muse app listing brands that have formally opted in. The outcome of this standards effort will determine whether AI agents can operate at scale in high-frequency consumer contexts such as e-commerce, air travel, and dining — a challenge analogous in scope to the formation of web crawler norms in the early search era.

items.title: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 視覺廣告並整合 14 家衡量工具：AI 廣告生態系正式成形
items.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT visual ads alongside image generation, integrates 14 measurement partners
items.summary: OpenAI 在圖像生成結果旁新增視覺廣告格式，同步整合 AppsFlyer、Adjust、DoubleVerify 等 14 家衡量與品牌安全工具，10 月底先在美國上線，觸及每週 12 億用戶。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched visual display ads alongside AI-generated images in ChatGPT, integrating 14 measurement partners including AppsFlyer, Adjust, and DoubleVerify for brand safety pilots, rolling out in the U.S. later in October targeting 1.2 billion weekly users.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 代理商需評估是否將 ChatGPT 廣告庫存納入媒介計劃，尤其是有圖像生成需求的品牌活動。
items.why_en: Agencies must assess whether ChatGPT ad inventory belongs in their media plans, especially for campaigns with image-generation touchpoints.
highlights: 廣告格式出現於圖像生成旁，清楚標示為廣告，OpenAI 聲明不影響 ChatGPT 的回答內容。
衡量生態系包含 AppsFlyer、Adjust、Triple Whale 等歸因工具，以及 DoubleVerify 與 IAS 的品牌適性試驗，Fospha 等提供全通路歸因。
廣告庫存先服務免費及低費訂閱用戶，繼 8 月印度擴展後，此次在美國正式推出視覺化格式。
highlights_en: Ads appear alongside AI-generated images, clearly labeled, with OpenAI stating they won't influence ChatGPT's answers.
Measurement stack includes AppsFlyer, Adjust, Triple Whale for attribution, plus DoubleVerify and IAS brand-suitability pilots, and Fospha for full-funnel measurement.
Inventory initially targets free and low-cost subscribers; this U.S. launch follows an August 2026 expansion into India.
items.detail:
OpenAI 自 2026 年 2 月正式在 ChatGPT 中引入廣告後，已運行逾七個月，目前正在兩個方向同步推進：擴充廣告格式，以及補強一直被廣告主詬病的衡量能力缺口。根據 Digiday 於 10 月 5 日在 Advertising Week New York 期間發布的報道，OpenAI 計劃在 10 月底於美國市場率先測試圖像廣告（image ads），投放場景鎖定在圖像生成對話中，廣告將清楚標示、與 ChatGPT 生成內容保持視覺區隔，且沿用既有格式欄位：廣告主名稱、標誌、標題、說明文字、落地頁連結與配圖。

衡量基礎設施是此次更新的核心。OpenAI 宣布整合超過十家衡量合作夥伴，Kochava 是已具名確認的合作方之一，功能涵蓋網頁與應用程式的轉化追蹤，並支援最終點擊以外的多觸點歸因。在地理增量（geo-based incrementality）測量方面，OpenAI 正與 Haus、Measured、WorkMagic 三家專業工具進行早期實驗，目標是讓廣告主能夠評估廣告投放對銷售增量的真實貢獻，而非僅依賴平台自報數字。品牌安全方面，DoubleVerify 與 Integral Ad Science 已完成受控環境下的試點測試，但兩者均不會獲取真實用戶對話內容，隱私邊界由 OpenAI 明確劃定。

此輪升級的市場背景是廣告主長期以來對 ChatGPT 廣告的三項核心不滿：衡量工具不足、廣告格式單一、庫存規模有限。Zeno Group 執行副總裁（付費社交）Shamsul Chowdhury 在 Advertising Week 上指出，ChatGPT 目前每日全球處理約 25 億次提示（prompts），而 Google 搜索每日約達 150 億次——前者體量是後者的六分之一。ChatGPT 現階段僅有一個廣告位，Google 則設有多個，廣告主普遍反映預算仍停留在測試規模，無法大規模增配資金，主要障礙正是衡量體系不完善。

從競爭格局審視，這次整合標誌著 OpenAI 從「試水期廣告平台」向「可量化投資回報廣告生態」的轉型嘗試。AppsFlyer、Adjust 等 14 家工具的整合若能落實，將填補廣告主最後一塊顧慮——當衡量工具鏈與品牌安全審核均到位，預算從測試轉向規模化投放的阻力將大幅降低。OpenAI 的每週 12 億活躍用戶基數提供了足夠的流量支撐，關鍵在於能否在 10 月底的美國測試中驗證廣告效果，並在年底前向全球市場推廣。
items.detail_en:
OpenAI has been running advertising in ChatGPT since February 2026, now seven months into the experiment, and is simultaneously advancing on two fronts: expanding ad formats and closing the measurement gaps that have frustrated advertisers since launch. According to Digiday's report published October 5 at Advertising Week New York, OpenAI plans to begin testing image ads in the United States later in October, placing them within image generation conversations. The ads will be clearly labeled and visually separated from ChatGPT-generated content, using an existing format structure: advertiser name, logo, headline, description, landing page, and image.

Measurement infrastructure is the centerpiece of this update. OpenAI announced integrations with more than ten measurement partners; Kochava is among the confirmed names, covering web and app conversion tracking and supporting multi-touch attribution beyond last click. For geo-based incrementality measurement — assessing the true incremental sales lift attributable to advertising — OpenAI is in early experimentation with Haus, Measured, and WorkMagic. On brand safety, DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science have completed pilots in controlled testing environments, with an explicit privacy constraint: neither partner will have access to actual user conversations.

The market context matters. Advertisers have consistently cited three complaints about ChatGPT advertising: inadequate measurement tools, limited ad formats, and insufficient inventory. Shamsul Chowdhury, EVP of Paid Social at Zeno Group, noted at Advertising Week that ChatGPT handles approximately 2.5 billion prompts per day globally, compared to roughly 15 billion daily searches on Google — placing ChatGPT at about one-sixth of Google's scale. ChatGPT currently has a single ad placement while Google offers multiple, and advertiser budgets have remained at test levels precisely because the measurement infrastructure has not given buyers sufficient confidence to scale.

Viewed through a competitive lens, this integration push signals OpenAI's attempt to graduate from an experimental ad platform to a measurable ROI-driven advertising ecosystem. With integrations spanning 14 measurement and brand safety tools — including AppsFlyer and Adjust — the friction that has kept budgets small stands to diminish meaningfully. OpenAI's base of one billion weekly active users provides sufficient traffic scale; the decisive question is whether the late-October U.S. image ad test can demonstrate credible performance metrics and build the case for a global rollout before year-end.

items.title: AppLovin 控告 Unity 竊取競標數據訓練 AI：廣告技術數據使用邊界引發全業界爭議
items.title_en: AppLovin sues Unity for secretly harvesting ad auction data to train AI models, implicating Google and others
items.summary: AppLovin 入稟舊金山法院，指控 Unity Ad Quality SDK 透過 AppLovin 特定連接器腳本，非法蒐集其贏得的競標數據、創意素材與收益事件，疑用於訓練競爭 AI 模型；Unity 否認不當行為。
items.summary_en: AppLovin filed suit in San Francisco alleging Unity's Ad Quality SDK used AppLovin-specific connector scripts to illegally harvest impression revenue and creative data from won auctions, potentially training rival AI models; Unity denies wrongdoing and claims its data came from publishers with permission.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 涉及 Google、Liftoff 等廣告技術夥伴，代理商需重新審視 SDK 整合協議中的數據使用條款。
items.why_en: The case implicates Google, Liftoff, and other ad tech partners — agencies should review data-use clauses in their SDK integration agreements.
highlights: AppLovin 指控 Unity 的 SDK 使用「AppLovin 特定連接器腳本」訂閱 AppLovin 內部的曝光與收益事件頻道，且可遠端逐應用程式配置。
AppLovin 稱收集的數據疑用於訓練 Unity 的廣告 AI 模型並複製 AppLovin 的廣告決策，Unity 聲稱數據來自出版商授權，AppLovin 的審核工具才更具侵入性。
訴狀指出 Unity 的技術同時觸及 Google、Liftoff、Digital Turbine 及 InMobi 的數據，引發業界對競爭者可合法觀察哪些共享廣告環境信號的廣泛爭議。
items.followup: 9 月 30 日我們報過 AppLovin 就數據收集申請臨時禁制令，Unity 反指其做法同等具侵入性。今日訴狀公開後，案件升級：AppLovin 指控 Unity SDK 透過「AppLovin 特定連接器腳本」直接訂閱其內部競標頻道，收集的數據疑用於訓練競爭 AI 模型，Google、Liftoff 等夥伴亦受波及——從廣告欺詐指控演變成廣告技術數據邊界的全業界爭議。
items.followup_en: On September 30 we reported AppLovin sought a temporary injunction over Unity data collection, with Unity counter-claiming AppLovin is equally intrusive. Today the filed complaint reveals escalating allegations: AppLovin claims Unity used AppLovin-specific connector scripts to subscribe directly to its internal auction channels, with data allegedly used to train rival AI models — implicating Google, Liftoff, and others and turning what began as a fraud claim into an industry-wide debate over the data-use boundaries in shared ad environments.
items.detail:
AppLovin 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日在舊金山聯邦法院提出訴訟，被告是其移動廣告市場的直接競爭對手 Unity。這是移動廣告技術行業迄今涉及 AI 模型訓練數據邊界最為明確的一場訴訟，其結果將對整個程式化廣告生態的數據使用規範產生深遠影響。

訴訟的技術核心是 Unity Ad Quality SDK 的運作方式。AppLovin 在訴狀中指控，Unity 將 Ad Quality SDK 嵌入發布商應用程式後，利用 AppLovin 特定連接器腳本（connector scripts），與 AppLovin 自家 SDK 內部的回調（callbacks）互動，並訂閱一條 AppLovin 內部的曝光及收益事件頻道。透過這條路徑，Unity 能夠蒐集 AppLovin 競標並贏得的廣告交易數據，包括：實際投放的廣告創意素材、用戶身份識別資訊、每次曝光的收益數字，以及曝光後的用戶互動行為。AppLovin 特別強調，Unity 涉嫌獲取的數據，甚至包括 Unity 本身並未參與競標的廣告交易——即徹底以第三方觀察者身份坐取競爭情報。更令 AppLovin 警惕的是，Unity 可遠端設定以應用程式為單位的蒐集開關，意味著蒐集行為可按需精準調控。

Unity 的回應分兩個層次：其一，所有數據均來自發布商應用程式或用戶設備，且獲得發布商授權，並非「來自 AppLovin」；其二，AppLovin 自身的 Ad Review 產品同樣審查廣告素材，批評方是「五十步笑百步」。AppLovin 對此有具體反駁：Ad Review 僅限於 AppLovin MAX 流量中介平台上的曝光，且明確排除用於訓練廣告模型；Unity 提出的「五個工作日內遠端停止蒐集 MAX 中介競拍數據」方案，附帶了解決整體糾紛的前提條件，且無法追溯處理已蒐集的歷史數據。

此案的連帶效應不止於兩家公司。訴狀中同時點名 Google、Liftoff、Digital Turbine、InMobi，指 Ad Quality SDK 在蒐集數據時亦涉及上述廣告網絡的交易信號。移動廣告生態中，一個應用程式同時運行多家競爭平台 SDK 的情況極為普遍，競標信號、曝光事件、收益數據均在同一沙盒內流轉。這場訴訟提出了行業至今未有定論的核心問題：當多個競爭平台共同參與同一筆廣告交易時，哪些信號在法律與商業倫理上屬於「合法可觀察範圍」，哪些又構成不當蒐集——尤其是當這些數據被用於訓練能夠預測競爭對手出價行為的 AI 模型時。
items.detail_en:
AppLovin filed a federal lawsuit in San Francisco on September 29, 2026 against Unity, its direct rival in the mobile advertising market. This is the most explicitly framed legal challenge yet in the ad tech industry over the boundaries of AI model training data, and its outcome is likely to set precedents for data use norms across programmatic advertising.

The technical core of the complaint centers on how Unity's Ad Quality SDK operates. AppLovin alleges that after Unity embeds Ad Quality into publisher apps, it uses AppLovin-specific connector scripts to interact with callbacks inside AppLovin's own SDK and subscribe to an internal impression and revenue events channel. Through this pathway, Unity allegedly collects data from ad transactions that AppLovin competed for and won — including the actual ad creatives served, user identity signals, per-impression revenue figures, and post-impression engagement behavior. AppLovin's filing goes further: it claims Unity may have captured data from auctions Unity never participated in at all, effectively positioning itself as a third-party intelligence observer inside AppLovin's transaction flow. A particularly concerning capability alleged is remote per-app configuration: Unity could reportedly toggle data collection on or off for individual apps at will, enabling targeted intelligence gathering.

Unity's defense operates on two levels. First, it asserts all data was obtained from publishers' apps or users' devices with publisher permission — not 'from AppLovin.' Second, it argues that AppLovin's own Ad Review product is 'far more intrusive,' as it also inspects ad creatives. AppLovin counters precisely: Ad Review applies only to impressions running through its MAX mediation platform, and it explicitly does not train advertising models. Unity's offer to remotely stop collecting MAX-mediated auction data within five business days was contingent on resolving the broader dispute and, critically, would not address data already collected historically.

The case has cascading implications beyond the two principals. The filing also names Google, Liftoff, Digital Turbine, and InMobi, alleging that Ad Quality SDK's collection touched transaction signals from those networks as well. In mobile advertising, it is standard for a single app to run SDKs from multiple competing platforms simultaneously — bid signals, impression events, and revenue data all circulate within the same sandbox. This lawsuit surfaces the question the industry has not yet resolved: when multiple competing platforms co-participate in a single ad transaction, which signals are legally and ethically within the observable range of each party, and which constitute improper harvesting — particularly when that data feeds AI models designed to predict and counter competitors' bidding behavior.

items.title: Stagwell 以代理式 AI 平台 Machine OS 重組 Assembly，在 50 個市場推出 Stagwell Media
items.title_en: Stagwell launches Stagwell Media powered by agentic AI platform Machine OS, built on Assembly's performance foundation

items.detail:
Stagwell 於 2026 年 10 月 6 日正式宣布以代理式 AI 平台 Machine OS 為核心，將旗下績效媒體代理公司 Assembly 重新整合，對外推出全新品牌 Stagwell Media，服務版圖一次覆蓋逾 50 個市場。此次整合並非簡單的品牌改名，而是把 Assembly 多年累積的程序化購買與績效媒體能力，與 Stagwell 自行開發的科技堆疊深度融合，形成一個由 AI 自動執行跨渠道媒體決策的作業體系。

Machine OS 是這次架構的技術核心。它旗下包含數個模組：The Media Machine 負責自動化媒體規劃與投放優化；Stagwell Search+ 專責搜尋廣告管理；Stagwell Curate 則處理受眾策劃與資料融合。三個模組串聯後，可在不同市場同步執行品牌活動，而無需各地團隊逐一手動操盤。集團主席兼行政總裁 Mark Penn 公開表示：「傳統媒體代理公司的模式並非為媒體的未來而建，Stagwell Media 才是。」這句話直接點出集團對現有代理行業運作方式的判斷——依賴人工協調、跨市場複製執行的舊模式已出現結構性效率瓶頸。

Stagwell Media 的全球執行由多位區域領導人分擔。Liz Rutgersson 擔任全球及美國行政總裁，直接管理核心市場的客戶業務；Connie Chan 出任亞太區行政總裁兼亞太區首席增長官，她明確指出「僅憑接觸機會並不能創造優勢」，暗示平台的差異化在於 AI 將數據轉化為實際決策的速度與精準度。歐洲市場由 Bridget Hopkins 負責，印度由 Alap Ghosh 帶領，中東及北非則交由 Ravi Rao 主導，波蘭籍的 Kacper Klos 出任全球數位商務行政總裁，顯示集團刻意在各主要區域配置本地高管，而非全以美國總部遠端管理。

現有客戶名單已可見 Stagwell Media 的業務量級：聯想（Lenovo）、萬事達卡（Mastercard）、寶僑（P&G）以及物流集團 DP World 均已列名。這四個品牌橫跨科技、金融、快消與供應鏈，意味著新平台並非聚焦單一行業垂直，而是以跨類別的媒體執行能力作為核心賣點。Stagwell Media 在架構上亦與集團旗下的 Crispin、GALE、Goodstuff、Locaria 及 Stagwell Owned Media 等姊妹公司保持協作關係，為客戶提供創意與媒體的一體化服務選項。

從產業格局看，這次重組是 Stagwell 對 WPP、Publicis 等老牌傳播集團持續推進 AI 代理化的直接回應。WPP 已推出 WPP Open，Publicis 則深耕 CoreAI，各家都在用自有科技平台區隔定位。Stagwell 以 Machine OS 作為統一品牌對外輸出，將科技平台的名稱與媒體品牌掛鈎，試圖在客戶採購決策中建立「AI-native 媒體代理」的心智位置。全球首席媒體及商務主席 Slavi Samardzija 強調，客戶有權利要求一個圍繞自身商業目標構建的媒體夥伴，這一表述與集團的整體定位方向一致——從傳統服務提供者轉型為以 AI 驅動成效為核心的商業夥伴。
items.detail_en:
On October 6, 2026, Stagwell officially announced the launch of Stagwell Media, a new entity built by restructuring its performance media agency Assembly around the agentic AI platform Machine OS. The rollout covers more than 50 markets simultaneously and represents a substantive architectural shift rather than a rebranding exercise — Assembly's accumulated programmatic buying and performance media capabilities are now fused with Stagwell's proprietary technology stack to create a system where AI executes cross-channel media decisions automatically.

Machine OS is the operational core of this architecture and comprises several distinct modules. The Media Machine handles automated media planning and campaign optimization; Stagwell Search+ manages search advertising; and Stagwell Curate oversees audience curation and data integration. Together, these modules allow brand campaigns to run across markets concurrently without requiring local teams to manage execution manually. Chairman and CEO Mark Penn stated plainly: 'The traditional media agency model wasn't built for the future of media. Stagwell Media is.' The remark directly addresses the structural inefficiency Penn sees in the legacy model — manual coordination and market-by-market replication of execution.

Stagwell Media's global operation is structured around a distributed leadership team. Liz Rutgersson serves as Global and US CEO, overseeing core market client relationships. Connie Chan, appointed CEO of APAC and Chief Growth Officer for Stagwell APAC, noted that 'access alone does not create advantage,' signaling that the platform differentiates on the speed and precision with which AI converts data into actionable decisions. Europe is led by Bridget Hopkins, India by Alap Ghosh, MENA by Ravi Rao, and Kacper Klos, based in Poland, serves as Global CEO of Digital Commerce. The deliberate placement of regional executives reflects a governance model where local market leadership is empowered rather than managed remotely from US headquarters.

The current client roster signals the scale at which Stagwell Media is operating: Lenovo, Mastercard, P&G, and logistics group DP World are all confirmed. These four brands span technology, financial services, consumer goods, and supply chain management, indicating that the new platform positions itself around cross-category media execution capability rather than a single industry vertical. Stagwell Media also operates in close collaboration with sister agencies including Crispin, GALE, Goodstuff, Locaria, and Stagwell Owned Media, giving clients the option of integrated creative and media services under one network.

In the broader competitive landscape, this restructuring is a direct response to the ongoing AI-agentification strategies of legacy holding groups. WPP has deployed WPP Open, Publicis has invested deeply in CoreAI, and each is using a proprietary technology platform to establish market differentiation. Stagwell's move to externally brand its platform as Machine OS — and tie that name explicitly to the media brand — is an attempt to build 'AI-native media agency' positioning in client procurement decisions. Global Chair of Media and Commerce Slavi Samardzija stated that clients deserve a media partner built around their ambitions, a framing consistent with Stagwell's broader repositioning from traditional service provider to an AI-driven commercial partner.

items.title: Facebook 在印度測試「Reels 優先」介面：4 億用戶開啟即進入全螢幕短影片
items.title_en: Facebook tests Reels-first interface in India: 400M users land in full-screen video on launch
items.summary: Meta 在印度（逾 4 億用戶）測試開啟 Facebook 直接進入全螢幕 Reels 介面，傳統動態降為次要標籤，89% 印度 Z 世代每日使用 Reels，此模式或擴展至其他亞洲市場及美國。
items.summary_en: Meta is testing a Reels-first Facebook interface in India (400M+ users) where opening the app lands users in full-screen video; the classic feed moves to a second tab, with 89% of Indian Gen Z using Reels daily and a potential expansion to other Asia markets.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 若此模式推廣至香港、東南亞，Facebook 動態廣告的觸及將被短影片廣告格式取代，需提前準備影片素材。
items.why_en: If rolled out to Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, Facebook feed ad reach will be displaced by Reels formats — time to build video creative inventory now.
highlights: Meta 在印度測試全螢幕 Reels 優先介面，傳統動態降為第二標籤；用戶可選擇退回動態優先版面。
印度是 Facebook 最大市場（逾 4 億用戶），Meta 報告顯示至少 97% 印度用戶每日在 Meta 平台觀看影片，89% Z 世代每日使用 Reels。
印度過去多次作為 Meta 介面測試的先導市場，分析認為成功後有機會擴展至其他亞洲市場及美國。
highlights_en: Meta is testing a Reels-first Facebook interface in India where users land in full-screen video by default; they can opt out to the traditional feed.
India is Facebook's largest market with 400M+ users; Meta reports 97% of Indian users watch video on its platforms daily, with 89% of Gen Z using Reels every day.
India has historically been a test-and-scale market for Meta interface changes, with analysts expecting a potential rollout to other Asian markets and eventually the U.S.
items.detail:
Meta 於 2026 年 10 月正式在印度啟動 Facebook「Reels 優先」介面測試，用戶開啟應用程式後直接進入全螢幕短影片流，傳統動態（Feed）降格為第二個標籤。這並非突如其來的決定：Facebook 負責人 Tom Alison 早在 2026 年 7 月已公開披露有關測試計劃，而 Instagram 則早一步於 2025 年 9 月在印度和南韓率先試驗同一介面邏輯。此次 Facebook 在印度的實測是集團將短影片置於核心入口的系統性推進，而非孤立的 A/B 測試。

選擇印度作為首個測試市場有明確的數據基礎。Facebook 在印度的用戶規模超過 4 億，是全球最大的單一國家市場。根據 Meta 委託調查的數據，97% 的受訪印度用戶每日在 Meta 旗下平台觀看影片；印度 Z 世代受訪者中，89% 每天使用 Reels，Meta 將印度定性為 Reels 的「個人與主要螢幕」。若以平台行為數據補充，年輕成人在 Facebook 的使用時間中，約 60% 已在觀看影片，Feed 的相對地位早已下滑，介面調整只是在正式承認既成事實。

Facebook 與短影片的關係可追溯至 2020 年印度封禁 TikTok 後的市場真空。當時 Instagram 迅速在印度測試 Reels 的獨立分頁，搶佔短影片受眾；此後幾年，Meta 持續加碼，2025 年 6 月宣布所有 Facebook 影片統一以 Reels 格式分享，同年將影片分頁正式更名為「Reels」。此次開啟即進入 Reels 的介面改動，是這條產品演化線的最新一步，也是 Meta 在 YouTube Shorts 與 Instagram 本身之間競爭版圖中，主動讓 Facebook 承擔更多短影片流量的一次結構性調整。

測試設計保留了退出選項：用戶可選擇關閉 Reels 優先模式，傳統動態仍以標籤形式存在，並非完全消失。這一設計有助於降低用戶流失風險，同時讓 Meta 收集選擇退出的比例與行為數據，以評估市場接受度。根據現有時間表，Meta 計劃於 2027 年評估在美國市場推廣同一模式的可行性；若印度測試期間的留存率與廣告收益表現符合預期，其他亞洲市場可能更早跟進。

對廣告主而言，這次介面調整的實際意義在於觸及路徑的改變：全螢幕 Reels 流的首屏曝光位置將成為 Facebook 在印度市場最具競爭力的廣告版位，原有的 Feed 廣告重要性相對下降。品牌需要評估現有的印度市場 Facebook 創意素材是否適配豎版全螢幕格式，以及 Reels 廣告的出價策略是否需要隨入口優先級的提升而重新配置預算。這對正在印度市場投放 Facebook 廣告的品牌來說，是一個需要主動跟進而非等待觀望的產品變化。
items.detail_en:
In October 2026, Meta began live testing a Reels-first interface on Facebook in India, where users who open the app are taken directly into a full-screen short video feed, with the traditional Feed demoted to a secondary tab. This was not a sudden move: Facebook head Tom Alison had publicly outlined the test plan in July 2026, and Instagram had already piloted the same interface logic in India and South Korea back in September 2025. The current Facebook test in India is part of a systematic push to position short-form video as the primary entry point across Meta's platforms, not an isolated A/B experiment.

The choice of India as the first test market rests on concrete data. Facebook has over 400 million users in India, its largest single-country market globally. According to Meta-commissioned survey data, 97% of Indian respondents watch video daily on Meta platforms, and 89% of Indian Gen Z respondents use Reels every day. Meta has described Reels as India's 'personal and primary screen.' Platform behavior data adds further context: approximately 60% of the time young adults spend on Facebook is already devoted to watching video, meaning the Feed's relative significance had already declined well before the interface change was implemented.

Facebook's relationship with short-form video traces back to the market vacuum created when India banned TikTok in 2020. Instagram moved quickly at the time to test a dedicated Reels tab in India, capturing short-video audiences in the absence of TikTok. Meta continued investing in the format over subsequent years, announcing in June 2025 that all Facebook videos would be shared as Reels, and formally renaming its video tab 'Reels' the same year. The current interface change — defaulting to Reels on app open — is the latest step in that product evolution and represents a structural decision to route more short-video traffic explicitly through Facebook, alongside YouTube Shorts and Instagram itself.

The test design includes an opt-out option: users can disable the Reels-first mode, and the traditional Feed remains accessible as a tab rather than being removed entirely. This reduces the risk of user attrition while allowing Meta to track the opt-out rate and associated behavior patterns, providing data to assess market acceptance. According to the current roadmap, Meta plans to evaluate a U.S. rollout of the same model in 2027; if retention and advertising revenue metrics from the India test meet expectations, other Asian markets could follow earlier.

For advertisers, the practical implication of this interface change is a shift in the reach pathway: the first-screen inventory within the full-screen Reels feed will become the most competitive ad placement on Facebook in India, while the relative importance of Feed placements declines. Brands will need to assess whether their existing Facebook creative assets for the Indian market are adapted for vertical full-screen format, and whether Reels bidding strategies need to be rebalanced to reflect the new prominence of the entry point. This is a product development that warrants active evaluation rather than a wait-and-see posture for any brand currently running Facebook campaigns in India.

items.title: Pinterest 推出 AI 美容指南：靈感圖即時轉化為沙龍費用估算與預約行動計劃
items.title_en: Pinterest launches AI Beauty Guides: visual inspiration converted into salon cost estimates and booking action plans
items.summary: Pinterest 發布 Beauty Guides 功能，點擊「Get the Guide」後，AI 將美容靈感圖翻譯成專業美容術語、費用估算與維護時程，涵蓋髮型、髮色與指甲類別，強化平台的購買漏斗下游功能。
items.summary_en: Pinterest launched Beauty Guides: tapping 'Get the Guide' on a beauty Pin triggers Pinterest Intelligence AI to translate visual inspiration into professional stylist terminology, cost estimates, and maintenance schedules across hairstyle, hair color, and nail categories.
items.why: 美容品牌與沙龍可直接受益：高意圖受眾在 Pinterest 完成發現與初步決策，下游轉化路徑縮短。
items.why_en: Beauty brands and salons benefit directly: high-intent audiences complete discovery and initial decision-making on Pinterest, shortening the downstream conversion path.
highlights: Pinterest Intelligence AI 將靈感圖翻譯成專業術語（如「balayage」、「root melt」、「almond nails」），讓用戶與美容師溝通時更準確表達需求。
功能同時提供預約所需時間與費用估算，以及後續維護頻率（補色、修剪等），減少消費者在預約前的資訊不對稱。
Beauty Guides 強化了 Pinterest 在購買漏斗下游的功能定位，從「保存靈感」進化為「觸發預約行動」。
items.detail:
Pinterest 於 2026 年 10 月 6 日發布 Beauty Guides 功能，以 Pinterest Intelligence 為技術底層——結合視覺辨識與生成式 AI——將用戶儲存的美容靈感圖轉化為一份可直接帶去沙龍使用的行動計劃。觸發方式極為直接：用戶在瀏覽美容相關 Pin 圖時，畫面上會出現「Get the Guide」按鍵，點擊後系統即根據圖片內容生成一份結構化指南，不需要用戶自行描述或搜尋額外資訊。

這份指南的核心價值在於語言轉譯。用戶通常以「這張圖的感覺」作為溝通基礎，而美髮師或美甲師在技術上使用的是截然不同的專業詞彙。Beauty Guides 自動完成這層轉換：以髮色為例，系統會辨識靈感圖並輸出「balayage」（漸層染）或「root melt」（根部過渡染）等術語；美甲部分則輸出「almond nails」（杏仁形甲）等形狀描述。這些術語直接可用於向技術人員溝通，消除了因語言不精準導致成品與預期落差的常見問題。

除術語外，指南同時提供三類輔助資訊。其一是時間估算，列出每個施作步驟所需的工時；其二是費用區間，以漸層染為例，文章明確指出費用可能進入數百美元的範疇，幫助用戶在預約前建立實際的預算預期；其三是維護時程，涵蓋修剪頻率、補色或護理的建議週期。這三項資訊組合後，實際上是把沙龍預約的前期調查工作完全前置到 Pinterest 平台內，讓用戶在按下預約鍵之前已掌握足夠的成本與時間資訊。

功能覆蓋四個類別：髮型（hairstyle）、髮色（hair color）、甲形（nail shape）與甲面（nail finish）。這四類的共同特點是：靈感來源高度視覺化、消費決策前必須查詢專業術語與費用、且維護週期明確——這使它們成為 AI 指南化的高適配場景。地理開放範圍目前未有官方說明，屬於推出初期常見的資訊缺口。

Beauty Guides 在商業邏輯上是 Pinterest 近年持續強化的購買漏斗下游布局的延伸。Pinterest 長期以靈感板（inspiration board）聞名，其核心用戶行為是「儲存」而非「立即購買」，平台的挑戰在於如何縮短從靈感到行動的距離。透過把費用估算與預約準備資訊直接嵌入靈感瀏覽流程，Pinterest 在不改變用戶使用習慣的前提下，大幅壓縮了從「看到喜歡的」到「準備預約」之間的摩擦。對品牌和服務商而言，這意味著 Pinterest 上的美容內容正在從純粹的上漏斗觸及工具，逐步演變為帶有明確轉換意圖信號的下漏斗媒介，廣告投放策略與創意方向值得相應調整。
items.detail_en:
Pinterest launched Beauty Guides on October 6, 2026, powered by Pinterest Intelligence — a combination of visual recognition and generative AI — that converts saved beauty inspiration Pins into a structured action plan users can bring directly to a salon appointment. The trigger mechanism is straightforward: while browsing beauty-related Pins, a 'Get the Guide' button appears, and tapping it generates a structured guide based on the image content without requiring the user to type a description or perform additional searches.

The core value of the guide lies in language translation. Users typically communicate by pointing to a photo and saying 'I want this look,' while hair stylists and nail technicians work in a professional vocabulary that is entirely different. Beauty Guides automates this translation layer: for hair color, the system identifies the inspiration image and outputs terms like 'balayage' or 'root melt'; for nails, it produces shape descriptors like 'almond nails.' These terms are immediately usable in a conversation with a technician, eliminating the common problem of misalignment between the client's intent and the final result caused by imprecise communication.

Beyond terminology, each guide provides three categories of supporting information. First, a time estimate that lists the working hours required for each application step. Second, a cost range — the article specifically notes that balayage 'goes into the hundreds of dollars,' giving users a realistic budget expectation before they book. Third, a maintenance schedule covering recommended trimming frequency, toning, and touch-up intervals. Together, these three types of information effectively front-load all pre-appointment research into the Pinterest platform itself, ensuring users arrive at the booking decision already equipped with the cost and time data they need.

The feature launches across four categories: hairstyle, hair color, nail shape, and nail finish. What these four share is that inspiration is highly visual, pre-decision research requires professional terminology and cost data, and maintenance cycles are clearly defined — making them particularly well-suited to AI-guided action planning. Geographic availability has not been officially specified at launch, a common information gap in early rollout stages.

In commercial terms, Beauty Guides is an extension of Pinterest's ongoing effort to strengthen the lower end of the purchase funnel. Pinterest has long been associated with inspiration boards, and its core user behavior centers on saving rather than immediate purchasing. The platform's persistent challenge is compressing the distance between inspiration and action. By embedding cost estimates and appointment-preparation information directly into the inspiration browsing experience, Pinterest substantially reduces friction between 'seeing something I like' and 'ready to book' — without altering the user's existing behavior patterns. For brands and service providers, this signals that beauty content on Pinterest is evolving from a purely upper-funnel awareness tool into a lower-funnel medium with clear intent signals, warranting corresponding adjustments to advertising strategy and creative direction.

items.detail:
Advertising Week New York 2026（AWNY）今年首次設立「首席創作者官」（Chief Creator Officer）職位，由網路創作者 Dhar Mann 出任。Mann 以旗下製作公司 Dhar Mann Studios 聞名，其勵志短片在 YouTube 與 Facebook 累積逾百億次觀看，是目前美國最具商業影響力的創作者之一。AWNY 為他設定的目標是：在未來 12 個月內為入駐品牌撮合總計 1 億美元的合作交易。

AWNY 圍繞這一目標設計了一系列活動機制。會期間設有「創作者挑戰賽」，以 Zillow 金鑰匙作為獎品；Nick Cannon 主持「蒙面 CMO」環節，邀請品牌高管以創作者身份上台；Christina Milian 帶領創作者卡拉 OK 之夜；Fat Joe 則坐鎮一間專為撮合交易而設的閉門房間。CEO Brad Hoos 解釋這一億美元目標的邏輯時說：「大而圓整的數字是人們容易產生共鳴的東西。」Mann 本人表示：「這個星期，人們會認識到原本不可能認識的人。」

業界對此反應不一。部分觀察人士認為，活動在創作者與品牌之間製造社交碰撞的設計確有新意，有助於 AWNY 在廣告節氣候趨冷的環境中保持吸引力。媒體分析師 Karissa Tuccio 形容此舉有助於 AWNY「維持自身的相關性」。

質疑聲音則集中在目標的可兌現性。媒體記者 Lauren Lyster 指出，Mann 自身代表的是頂層創作者的合作標準，絕大多數與會創作者都難以複製同等條件的交易。更關鍵的結構性問題在於：品牌通常在每年第一、二季度確定第四季度預算分配，AWNY 在 10 月舉辦，意味著現場促成的合作幾乎不可能即時解鎖新增預算。1 億美元的目標，更像是一個吸引眼球的承諾，而非一份可以在 12 個月後交卷的財務計劃。
items.detail_en:
Advertising Week New York 2026 (AWNY) created a first-of-its-kind title this year — Chief Creator Officer — and appointed digital creator Dhar Mann to the role. Mann is best known for Dhar Mann Studios, whose motivational short-form videos have accumulated more than 10 billion views across YouTube and Facebook, making him one of the most commercially powerful creators in the United States. AWNY set him a target of brokering $100 million in total brand-creator deals within 12 months.

AWNY designed a series of structured activities around this ambition. During the conference, a "creator challenge" offered a Zillow golden key as the prize. Nick Cannon hosted a "Masked CMO" segment that invited brand executives to present on stage as creators. Christina Milian led a creator karaoke night. Fat Joe took up residence in a closed-door deal-making room specifically designed to facilitate introductions between brands and creators. CEO Brad Hoos explained the rationale behind the $100 million figure: "Big round numbers are something that people can connect with." Mann himself said: "People will meet people during this week that they otherwise would not have met."

Industry reaction was mixed. Some observers credited the event's design — creating structured social collisions between creators and brand decision-makers — as genuinely novel, helping AWNY sustain relevance in a cooling conference environment. Media analyst Karissa Tuccio described the initiative as helping AWNY "stay relevant."

Skeptics focused on the target's achievability. Media reporter Lauren Lyster noted that Mann's own deal standards represent the ceiling of the creator economy, conditions that the vast majority of attending creators cannot replicate. The more fundamental structural issue is timing: brands typically lock in Q4 budget allocations during Q1 and Q2 of the same year. AWNY takes place in October, which means deals brokered on-site are unlikely to unlock new incremental spending. The $100 million headline reads more like a compelling hook than a financial commitment that can be audited 12 months from now.
